title: Endoscopic Implantation of Enteryx for the Treatment of GERD
brief_summary: The study objective is to assess the long term safety and effectiveness of Enteryx device in commercial use. The long-term effects beyond one year of treatment with Enteryx have not been established.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* GERD responsive to and requiring daily PPI therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Esophageal varices, particularly related to portal hypertension • Patients whom the physician determines to be a poor candidate for endoscopic procedures and/or anesthesia.

Patients must also be willing to allow their data to be shared with the Sponsor and FDA.
